notes: Multi Studio version 3.0.1: **Unified Highlighted Manuscript Editor (Seamless Direct Typing with Live Highlights)**: Merged Review Mode and Direct Edit into a single, cohesive writing canvas. You can now type, edit, paste, format, and select text freely at all times without ever losing colorful revision highlights, near-match underlines, or search highlights. Placing your cursor or clicking on any highlighted passage opens the review card right beside your text, providing a natural and uninterrupted writing experience with zero mode switching., **Custom Replacement Text for Near-Match & Exact Patches**: You can now enter and customize your own replacement wording before applying any revision. On suggestion cards in the sidebar, clicking "Edit" opens a dedicated text area where you can adjust the proposed wording and click "Apply Custom". Inside the in-manuscript review popup card, the "Patch Replacement" section is now an editable box, complete with a "Customized" badge and "Reset" button for quick adjustments., **Simplified Two-Way View Switcher**: Streamlined the top toolbar controls into a clean toggle between the **Manuscript Editor** and the side-by-side **Diff Inspector**, eliminating unnecessary mode buttons while displaying a helpful live badge showing how many revisions remain highlighted in your document., **Unified Find & Replace in One Toolbar Button (Cmd+F / Cmd+H)**: Consolidated Search and Replace into a single button on the toolbar, eliminating redundant buttons and extra clicks. Clicking the "Find & Replace" button or pressing `Cmd+F` / `Cmd+H` (`Ctrl+F` / `Ctrl+H` on Windows) opens an integrated panel where the search box and replacement controls are presented together, allowing you to search, review match counts, replace individual occurrences, or batch replace all across your manuscript seamlessly., **Dedicated Status Filter Tabs & Clutter-Free Card Views**: The top filter bar includes dedicated tabs for **All**, **Found**, **Near Match**, **Not Found**, and **Applied** for instant one-click filtering. The **All** tab organizes mixed cards into distinct, collapsible groups with color-coded count badges, while individual filter tabs display cards directly in a clean, uncluttered list without duplicate headers., **In-Manuscript Text Searcher (Cmd+F / Ctrl+F)**: Added a built-in search tool directly on the document editor canvas accessible via the toolbar "Find" button or `Cmd+F` (`Ctrl+F` on Windows). It features real-time occurrence counts (e.g., `1 of 4`), smooth Previous/Next match navigation (`Enter` / `Shift+Enter`), case sensitivity toggle (`Aa`), and instant visual highlighting across your script in both Review Mode and Direct Edit., **Quick "Search in Manuscript" for Not Found Notes**: To prevent users from getting stuck when revision notes report "Not Found", each Not Found card now features a prominent **"Search in Manuscript"** button. Clicking it instantly opens the search tool pre-filled with the original phrase, jumping straight to where that scene or dialogue is in your script so you can easily review and edit it., **Customizable Patch Labels & Universal Multi-Language Support**: If your revision notes use custom terms instead of standard labels (such as `Draft:`, `Fix:`, `Before:`, `After:`, or personal abbreviations), you can now open the "Custom Labels" drawer inside the Import dialog and specify your own custom line prefixes. In addition, the importer now automatically recognizes native labels in Khmer (`បន្ទាត់ដើម`/`បន្ទាត់កែ`), Thai (`ข้อความเดิม`/`ข้อความใหม่`), Chinese (`原句`/`改句`), Japanese (`元の文`/`修正後`), markdown tables (`| Original | Replacement |`), and arrow notations (`"Old text" -> "New text"`)., **Smart Near-Match Detector with Likely Match Percentage**: When revision notes don't find an exact match in the manuscript due to minor typos, missing words, or particle variations, TTS Studio now intelligently scans your manuscript for the most probable matching passage. Instead of showing a dead "Not Found" state, the suggestion card displays a "Likely Match" badge with an estimated similarity percentage (e.g., 93%), highlights the differences directly in the card, and provides a one-click **"Align & Apply"** button to accept the correction cleanly., **Interactive Near-Match Highlighting in Review Mode**: Candidate passages detected by the Smart Near-Match Detector are underlined with an amber dashed indicator directly within your story canvas in Review Mode. Clicking on the candidate passage displays the floating review card where you can inspect differences and align the patch without hunting through the document., **Diff Inspector Pending Patches Preview**: The Document Diff Inspector now features a live "Pending Preview" mode that shows you what your story script will look like before you accept any revision patches. You can seamlessly switch between inspecting anticipated changes or already applied edits, view word-level highlights, and click "Accept All" directly from the Diff Inspector toolbar., **Spacious & Sticky Review Popover**: The floating revision popup card in Review Mode has been enlarged to comfortably display longer sentences and complex scripts (such as Khmer) without cramping. It now sticks dynamically to the highlighted patch phrase as you scroll through your manuscript, automatically adjusting its position to remain in view., **Full-Canvas Editor & Single Unified Scrollbar**: Replaced the narrow, artificial box wrapper with an edge-to-edge, full-panel manuscript canvas. The editor textarea now directly spans the full width and height of the workspace with a single, unified scrollbar, eliminating nested scroll boxes and conflicting scrollbars. Real-time hardware scroll synchronization keeps backdrop highlights perfectly aligned with your text as you scroll., **Zero Black Screen on Backspace / Delete**: Completely removed JavaScript height recalculations and inline height resets, preventing textarea layout collapse and eliminating the black screen glitch when deleting text or pressing backspace., **Instant, Zero-Lag Manuscript Typing & Performance**: Completely eliminated typing lag, stutter, and slowdowns when writing or editing large story scripts in the Doc Replacer editor. Re-evaluating revision suggestions, searching for near-matches, and updating sidebar cards are now smoothly deferred until after you pause typing, ensuring keystrokes appear immediately with 100% fluid, responsive typing speed even when working with long multi-thousand-word manuscripts., **Uninterrupted Manuscript Writing & Typing**: Resolved an issue where writing in the manuscript canvas could immediately trigger the revision popover card and hijack the text selection cursor on keystrokes. Keystroke changes now dismiss any active popover immediately, search match selection is paused while typing, and scroll-to-target actions strictly run when explicitly clicking the Eye icon or selecting a card, enabling completely smooth, natural, and fluid writing., **Crystal-Clear Patch Popup Card & Legibility**: Removed hard-to-read strike-through styling from the Review Mode floating popup card, replacing it with cleanly labeled and colored "Original Line" and "Patch Replacement" boxes with high-contrast text and zero crossed-out characters for effortless reading across Khmer, Thai, English, and all languages., **Smooth Sticky Popover Overflow & Scrolling**: Resolved an issue where the review popup card could become stuck or float outside the editor window when scrolling through the document. The popover now accurately detects the editor's scroll boundaries, tucking away cleanly when a patch phrase scrolls out of view and returning smoothly into position when scrolled back in., **High-Contrast Dark Mode Headings & Labels**: Upgraded all purple and indigo headings, category badges, and tags across the Doc Replacer, review popup, and diff inspector to vibrant, high-contrast colors in dark mode for effortless legibility against dark backgrounds., **Instant Single-Press Undo for Patch Dismissal**: Fixed an issue where clicking "Dismiss" on a suggestion card required pressing Undo (`Cmd+Z` / `Ctrl+Z`) twice to restore the card. Streamlined history tracking with duplicate-entry prevention and synchronous stack indexing so that exactly one press of Undo restores the dismissed card immediately to review., **Conflict-Free Keyboard Shortcuts Across All Workspace Tools**: Isolated Doc Replacer keyboard shortcuts (`Cmd+Z`, `Ctrl+Z`, `Cmd+Y`, `Cmd+Shift+Z`, `Cmd+F`, and `Cmd+H`) so they only operate when the Doc Replacer tool is actively displayed on screen. When navigating between other tools like Speech Studio, Scriber, or File Renamer, shortcuts remain completely inactive, preventing accidental edits or conflicts with other features., **Seamless Typing, Formatting & Patch Undo Stack**: Unified manuscript typing, rich text formatting (bold, italics, scene headers), and patch actions into a synchronized history timeline. Cancels pending typing timers on undo to ensure every editing step, formatting change, and patch acceptance reverses and re-applies cleanly in order with zero lost words or double-press requirements., **Reliable "Locate in Manuscript" Eye Action**: Fixed an issue where clicking the Eye icon on an already selected card wouldn't re-scroll to the match after you scrolled away. Added timestamp-keyed target tracking with automatic multi-frame retry and a visual attention spotlight ring, ensuring clicking Eye or selecting a card consistently and smoothly centers the target phrase and displays its review popup every single time without requiring you to click another card first., **Smart Line Break, Blank Line & Layout Preservation**: When a single-line patch rule matches story text that spans across multiple lines or paragraphs (including blank lines, double line breaks, and custom indentations), accepting the patch now automatically detects the exact spacing gaps and preserves your blank lines and paragraph layout without stripping line breaks or forcing everything into a single line., **Accurate Khmer & Asian Punctuation Matching**: Enhanced search tolerances for Khmer full stops (Khan `។` and Bariyoosan `៕`) and CJK punctuation, ensuring patch rules reliably match multi-line sentences whether or not spaces exist after punctuation marks., **Multi-Line Patch Block Replacement**: Resolved an issue where replacing multi-line text passages stripped line breaks and forced paragraphs into a single line. Multi-line patch blocks now retain their exact line breaks and paragraph structure, keeping manuscript formatting intact and aligning cleanly row-by-row in the Diff Inspector., **Accurate Multiple Match Handling**: Fixed an issue where patch rules with multiple occurrences across a document could repeatedly push and duplicate words (such as turning "Arthur" into "Arthur Vance Vance") instead of cleanly replacing the targeted phrase., **Targeted Occurrence Acceptance**: When a revision suggestion appears in multiple locations across your script, you can now choose to accept the patch for that specific occurrence or apply it across all matches at once from the review popover., **Reliable Undo and Redo with Rich Text and Dismiss**: Dismissing or restoring a patch suggestion is now recorded in the history log, so pressing Undo (`Cmd+Z` / `Ctrl+Z`) safely reverts dismiss actions without jumping over recent edits or formatting changes. Rich text styling (scenes, bold, quotes) now seamlessly participates in undo and redo., **Patch Dismissal Restoration**: Fixed the "Restore" action on dismissed suggestion cards so it safely returns the rule back to pending review instead of unexpectedly forcing the patch into the text., **Cursor Text Selection in Suggestions Panel**: Enabled normal mouse cursor text selection across suggestion cards in the sidebar. You can now highlight and copy (`Cmd+C` / `Ctrl+C`) text directly from the Original Line and Patched Replacement boxes without unwanted card selection triggers.
